SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.board.mapper.selectBoardListCount */ COUNT(*) FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_pst A WHERE 1=1 AND A.bbs_id = #{bbsId}
AND A.pst_ttl LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND A.rgtr_id IN ( SELECT m.mbr_no FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_mbr_info m WHERE m.encpt_mbr_flnm = #{encryptedWriterKeyword} )
AND A.rgtr_id IN ( SELECT ei.emp_no FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_emp_info ei WHERE ei.emp_nm LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' )
AND A.pst_cn LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.board.mapper.selectBoardDetail */ A.pst_sn AS pstSn , A.bbs_id AS bbsId , A.pst_ttl AS pstTtl , A.pst_cn AS pstCn , A.pst_inq_cnt AS pstInqCnt , A.pst_kogl_cprgt_type_cd AS pstKoglCprgtTypeCd , A.atch_file_group_id AS atchFileGroupId , A.thmb_id AS thmbId , A.fix_yn AS fixYn , A.fix_bgng_ymd AS fixBgngYmd , A.fix_end_ymd AS fixEndYmd , A.vdo_url_addr AS vdoUrlAddr , A.expsr_yn AS expsrYn , A.wrtr_dept_nm AS wrtrDeptNm , A.mdfr_dept_nm AS mdfrDeptNm , A.rgtr_id AS rgtrId , TO_CHAR(A.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regDt , A.mdfr_id AS mdfrId , TO_CHAR(A.mdfcn_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS mdfcnDt FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_pst A WHERE A.pst_sn = #{pstSn}

/* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.community.board.mapper.insertBoard */ INSERT INTO kids_own.tb_pp_m_pst ( pst_sn , bbs_id , pst_ttl , pst_cn , pst_inq_cnt , pst_kogl_cprgt_type_cd , atch_file_group_id , thmb_id , fix_yn , fix_bgng_ymd , fix_end_ymd , vdo_url_addr , expsr_yn , wrtr_dept_nm , mdfr_dept_nm , rgtr_id , reg_dt , mdfr_id , mdfcn_dt , thmb_expln_cn , vdo_expln_cn ) VALUES ( #{pstSn} , #{bbsId} , #{pstTtl} , #{pstCn} , COALESCE(#{pstInqCnt}, 0) , #{pstKoglCprgtTypeCd} , COALESCE(#{atchFileGroupId}, ' ') , #{thmbId} , COALESCE(#{fixYn}, 'N') , #{fixBgngYmd} , #{fixEndYmd} , #{vdoUrlAddr} , COALESCE(#{expsrYn}, 'Y') , #{wrtrDeptNm} , #{mdfrDeptNm} , COALESCE(#{rgtrId}, '관리자') , NOW() , COALESCE(#{mdfrId}, '관리자') , NOW() , COALESCE(#{thmbExplnCn}, '') , COALESCE(#{vdoExplnCn}, '') )
mapper.select: SELECT c.asmt_cmnt_sn AS asmtCmntSn, c.asmt_sn AS asmtSn, c.inst_id AS instId, inst.inst_nm AS instNm, dept.dept_nm AS deptNm, mbr.encpt_mbr_flnm AS mbrNm, emp.emp_nm AS empNm, c.cmnt_dtl_cn AS cmntDtlCn, c.orgnl_up_cmnt_ans_sn AS orgnlUpCmntAnsSn, c.up_cmnt_ans_sn AS upCmntAnsSn, c.cmnt_ans_depth_seq AS cmntAnsDepth, c.cmnt_ans_sn AS cmntAnsSn, c.del_indct_yn AS delIndctYn, c.del_yn AS delYn, c.rgtr_id AS rgtrId, c.reg_dt AS regDt, c.mdfr_id AS mdfrId, c.mdfcn_dt AS mdfcnDt FROM kids_own.TB_CM_M_ASMT_CMNT c LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_INST inst ON c.inst_id = inst.brno LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_DEPT_INFO dept ON c.inst_id = dept.dept_no LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_MBR_INFO mbr ON c.rgtr_id = mbr.mbr_no LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_EMP_INFO emp ON c.rgtr_id = emp.emp_no WHERE c.asmt_sn = #{pstSn} AND c.bbs_id = #{bbsId} AND (c.del_yn IS NULL OR c.del_yn = 'N') ORDER BY COALESCE(c.orgnl_up_cmnt_ans_sn, c.asmt_cmnt_sn), c.orgnl_up_cmnt_ans_sn NULLS FIRST, c.cmnt_ans_sn, c.reg_dt

SELECT asmt_cmnt_sn AS asmtCmntSn, asmt_sn AS asmtSn, inst_id AS instId, cmnt_dtl_cn AS cmntDtlCn, orgnl_up_cmnt_ans_sn AS orgnlUpCmntAnsSn, up_cmnt_ans_sn AS upCmntAnsSn, cmnt_ans_depth_seq AS cmntAnsDepth, cmnt_ans_sn AS cmntAnsSn, del_indct_yn AS delIndctYn, del_yn AS delYn, rgtr_id AS rgtrId, reg_dt AS regDt, mdfr_id AS mdfrId, mdfcn_dt AS mdfcnDt, bbs_id AS bbsId FROM kids_own.TB_CM_M_ASMT_CMNT WHERE asmt_cmnt_sn = #{asmtCmntSn} AND asmt_sn = #{pstSn} AND bbs_id = #{bbsId}
